section: 4 Algebraic renormalization of SUSY gauge theories with constant ghosts
title: Analysis of the superconformal cohomology structure of N=4 super Yang-Mills
claim: Builds, with the Batalin-Vilkovisky method, a nilpotent extended BRST operator that includes the full (on-shell) superconformal symmetry of N=4 SYM through constant ghosts; argues with spectral sequences that its cohomology relevant for anomalies is trivial, so that no symmetry is anomalous, hence no conformal anomaly, hence finiteness to all orders.
theory: N=4 SYM in components, Wess-Zumino-type gauge, superconformal algebra realized with constant ghosts (details not verified)
symmetry_argument: triviality of the superconformal BV cohomology at ghost number one => all symmetries, including dilatations/special conformal transformations, survive renormalization => vanishing beta function

proved: (claimed in the abstract) triviality of the anomaly cohomology of the superconformal BV operator; not verified at equation level
assumed: that cohomological triviality suffices to impose the full superconformal Slavnov-Taylor identity order by order, which requires a quantum action principle for x-dependent, nonlinearly realized, on-shell-closing symmetries and normalization conditions compatible with dilatations in a massless theory (how this is handled was not visible)

evidence: INSPIRE abstract of CQG 9 (1992) 413 (INSPIRE recid 31722): BV construction of the superconformal nilpotent operator, spectral sequences, cohomology trivial, no conformal anomaly, all-order finiteness
cited as ref. [9] in hep-th/9507045 and as ref. [3] in hep-th/0605164 (only for conformal invariance / superconformal cohomology)
red_flags: all-order finiteness from a cohomology statement: in the standard algebraic treatment (Callan-Symanzik equation, supercurrent trace identities; cf. S4.04_Piguet1996 Secs. 7-8) the beta function multiplies the breaking of dilatations by the coupling-constant insertion and the renormalization scale; why this term is excluded by the superconformal consistency conditions is the crux and could not be checked
no later paper found that re-derives or audits the result; S4.12_BaulieuBossardSorella2006 cites it without assessment and gives its own (different) algebraic proof
not on arXiv; only the abstract was accessible
cross_checks: same conclusion (beta = 0 to all orders) from light-cone superspace (Mandelstam 1983; Brink-Lindgren-Nilsson 1983), N=2 extended superspace power counting (Howe-Stelle-Townsend 1984) and S4.12_BaulieuBossardSorella2006; explicit DR/DRED checks of beta = 0 at 3 and 4 loops are in section 1 records
source_access: abstract only (INSPIRE); secondary: cited in hep-th/9507045, hep-th/0605164
notes: Lead verified: CQG 9 (1992) 413 exists with this title; 46 citing records on INSPIRE, none of those inspected discusses the proof in detail.
